title: 第18章 杂役危机探查母巢第19章 洞穴鼠群
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神

炼气八层的修士，已经算是炼气后期的存在，在炼气境的修士中，属于极为强大的存在，与炼气初期，炼气中期，存在明显的分水岭。
炼气一层到炼气三层，又被称为炼气初期，这就是丹圣宗宗门杂役的水平。
这个境界的修士，在丹圣宗犹如牛马，死了也不会有人关心。
而炼气四层到炼气六层，乃是炼气中期，大多是外门杂役的管理人员，虽然也是牛马，但稍微高级一些，宗门一般不会主动打杀。
而炼气七层到炼气九层，这就属于外门的精锐。
若是天赋卓越，乃至是做出突出贡献，或者是每年通过外门大比，都有机会进入内门。
唯有内门弟子，才算是真正的丹圣宗弟子，在丹圣宗享受着最好的待遇。
像丹圣宗外门的采药峰、炼丹房等，全都是为这些内门弟子服务的。
那些内门弟子根本不会从事这些事情，只需要享受最好的资源，提升境界就好。
他们这些外门弟子，为他们负重前行。
他现在只是炼气三层，就算功法特殊，灵气也达到了七品，但是与炼气八层的修士相比，差距实在是太大了。
“你放心，我有分寸的，这些天就先委屈你了。”
李安轻叹一声道。
给人做牛马的滋味，李安前一世可是深深体会过。
听到李安关心的言语，兰月儿心头一暖，
“李哥哥，我虽然和师尊签订了契约，不过也算是好事，不然她可不会全力栽培我。”
说着，她就从怀中将两门炼丹术的副本拿出来，递给了李安。
“你看看这个，人阶炼丹术！一旦修成，足以将炼丹的成功率，提升到三层！”
李安望着兰月儿手中拿出的两本册子，顿时眼前一亮。

炼丹术！
这可是成为炼丹师的关键！
这种好东西，是那些没有师承的炼丹师，做梦都碰不到的好东西！
而一旦自己成为了炼丹师，今后炼丹失败，也有阴阳炉合成作为保底，而一旦炼制成功，融合之下，丹药的品阶必然有极大的提升！
相当于他的炼丹师品阶，间接的高出了其他炼丹师一品，乃至是两品！
今后在外获取资源就会容易很多！
毕竟，你可以不给一位九品炼丹师面子，八品乃至是七品炼丹师，就是在丹圣宗，也需要给几分薄面！
“这两本是我在参悟时候偷偷抄录下来的，李哥哥你先好好研究研究，等过段时间，师尊正式传授炼丹之法时，我再来找你！”
兰月儿没有在这里久留，迅速转身离开了。
而在她离开之后，李安的视线迅速落在了两本册子上。
如意炼丹术！
混元炼丹术！
都是人阶炼丹术。
其他炼丹师或许极为满意，但李安有阴阳炉在，自然是看不上这两种炼丹术。
只要再找到一门人阶炼丹术，融合之后，应该就能得到一门地阶炼丹术！
而地阶炼丹术，能将炼丹的成功率提升到四成，而且丹药的品质也会更好！
他如今灵魂达到了小成的地步，已经触及炼丹的资格，境界一旦突破到炼气四层，便可以搜集灵药灵材，尝试炼丹了！

The monks at the eighth level of Qi Refining are already considered to be in the later stage of Qi Refining. Among the monks in the Qi Refining Realm, they are extremely powerful beings. There is a clear dividing line between the early stage of Qi Refining and the middle stage of Qi Refining.
The first level of Qi refining to the third level of Qi refining is also called the early stage of Qi refining. This is the level of the Dan Sheng Sect's servants.
Monks at this level are like oxen and horses in the Alchemy Sect, and no one will care about them even if they die.
The fourth level to the sixth level of Qi refining is the middle stage of Qi refining. Most of them are managers of outer sect servants. Although they are also cattle and horses, they are slightly more advanced and the sect generally will not take the initiative to kill them.
As for the seventh level of Qi Refining to the ninth level of Qi Refining, these belong to the elite of the outer sect.
If you have outstanding talent, even make outstanding contributions, or pass the outer sect competition every year, you will have the opportunity to enter the inner sect.
Only the inner disciples are considered true disciples of the Alchemy Sect and enjoy the best treatment in the Alchemy Sect.
The medicine-collecting peaks and alchemy rooms of the outer sect of the Alchemy Saint Sect, etc., all serve these inner sect disciples.
Those inner disciples will not engage in these things at all, they only need to enjoy the best resources and improve their realm.
They, the outer disciples, bear the burden for them.
He is only at the third level of Qi refining now. Even though his technique is special and his spiritual energy has reached the seventh level, compared with the monks at the eighth level of Qi refining, the gap is really huge.
"Don't worry, I am sensible, I will wrong you first these days."
Li An sighed softly.
Li An had deeply experienced the feeling of being a bull and a horse for others in his previous life.
Hearing Li An's caring words, Lan Yue'er felt warm in her heart.
"Brother Li, although I signed a contract with Master, it is still a good thing, otherwise she would not have tried her best to cultivate me."
With that said, she took out two copies of alchemy from her arms and handed them to Li An.
"Look at this, human level alchemy! Once mastered, it will be enough to increase the success rate of alchemy to the third level!"
Li An's eyes suddenly lit up when he looked at the two booklets Lan Yue'er took out.
Alchemy!
This is the key to becoming an alchemist!
This kind of good thing is a good thing that those alchemists who have no apprenticeship can never come across in their dreams!
And once you become an alchemy master, if you fail to refine alchemy in the future, you will still have the Yin-Yang Furnace synthesis as a guarantee. Once the refining is successful, the grade of the elixir will be greatly improved after the fusion!
It is equivalent to his alchemist level, which is indirectly higher than other alchemists by one level, or even two levels!
It will be much easier to obtain resources outside in the future!
After all, you don’t have to give face to a ninth-grade alchemist, but to an eighth-grade or even seventh-grade alchemist, even in the Alchemy Sect, you still need to give some face!
"I secretly copied these two books when I was studying. Brother Li, please study carefully first. I will come back to you after a while when the master officially teaches the method of alchemy!"
Lan Yue'er didn't stay here long and quickly turned around and left.
After she left, Li An's eyes quickly fell on the two booklets.
Ruyi alchemy!
Hunyuan alchemy!
They are all human-level alchemy techniques.
Other alchemists may be extremely satisfied, but since Li An has the Yin and Yang Furnace, he naturally looks down on these two alchemy techniques.
As long as you find another human-level alchemy technique, after fusion, you should be able to get an earth-level alchemy technique!
The earth-level alchemy technique can increase the success rate of alchemy to 40%, and the quality of the elixir will be better!
Now that his soul has reached the level of minor success, he has reached the qualifications for alchemy. Once he breaks through to the fourth level of Qi refining, he can collect elixirs and spiritual materials and try to make alchemy!
